confirmed_client_bug.cause: Inner json.dumps ensure_ascii=False retains Unicode, outer json.dumps defaults ensure_ascii=True; curl config does not recognize JSON Unicode escape sequences and removes their backslashes.

original_actual_curl_loopback.unicode_original: degree sign, curly apostrophe, en dash, Hindi character, motorcycle emoji
original_actual_curl_loopback.decoded_wire_text: Unicode u00b0 u2019 u2013 u0915 ud83cudfcd

confirmed_client_bug.does_not_explain_all_http500: All six newer observed failures occur at composer before verifier; GEN003 and tiny controls are ASCII. Thus Unicode corruption is a distinct grounding-integrity defect, not established root cause of HTTP500.
confirmed_client_bug.fix: Outer data quotation explicitly ensure_ascii=False; inner JSON and UTF8 encoding unchanged. Header and URL quoting retain existing ASCII behavior.
